items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And that time I told him about Lewis Russell. I told him about the drummer, Bob Rand, Bonnie Big Eye. I told him about them. So they come up and Joe sent for them.

ctx.x: They all went. They all went.

They was kids then, just learning how to play trombone at that time. 1924, I got a letter from Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver was telling me that Lewis had quit him and was, was, had gone to work to Dreamlin, but was talking about leaving and going to New York City. And he'd say, uh, Lorenzo Teo had wrote and told Joe Oliver about the progress that I was making on my cornered, cause Joe had asked, who's all the battle house cornered players down there that could play like bunk and uh, all the good old boys. Lorenzo told…
Yeah, and where was your job?
